name: Evaporating saturation temperature
definition: Calculated from low-side pressure and refrigerant P-T data; use dew reference for superheat on zeotropic blends.

name: Condensing saturation temperature
definition: Calculated from high-side pressure and refrigerant P-T data; use bubble reference for subcooling on zeotropic blends.

name: Evaporator superheat
definition: Suction-line temperature at evaporator outlet/bulb location minus corresponding saturation temperature.

name: Total superheat
definition: Compressor-inlet suction temperature minus corresponding evaporating saturation temperature.

name: Subcooling
definition: Condensing saturation temperature minus liquid-line temperature.

name: Evaporator TD
definition: Entering-air/box temperature minus evaporating saturation temperature.

name: Condenser TD / CTOA
definition: Condensing saturation temperature minus condenser entering-air temperature; also called CTOA or condensing split for an air-cooled condenser.

name: Evaporator air delta-T
definition: Entering-air dry-bulb minus leaving-air dry-bulb in cooling.

name: Compression ratio
definition: Discharge absolute pressure divided by suction absolute pressure.

name: Air-side sensible capacity
definition: At standard dry-air conditions, approximately 1.08 × CFM × dry-bulb delta-T; coefficient varies with air properties.
